result.question: Compare childcare at both schools
result.answer:
Childcare at Rejoyce Caledon Community Child Care and Dalemount Child Care can be compared based on available information:

- Both centres offer before- and after-school programs for kindergarten and school-age children [2], [3].
- Rejoyce Caledon Community Child Care operates at Joyce Public School, located at 26 Joyce Parkway, North York, with centre hours of 7am–6pm Monday–Friday, and summer hours of 7am–5:30pm [1]. These are centre hours; exact before/after-school session times require confirmation with the provider [1].
- Dalemount Child Care operates at Glen Park Public School, located at 101 Englemount Avenue, North York [3].
- Both centres are listed as having no kindergarten or school-age childcare vacancies as of 2026-09-08 (Rejoyce) and 2026-09-09 (Dalemount) [2], [3].
- Both centres participate in the Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care (CWELCC) initiative, but this does not confirm individual fee structures or school-age discounts [2], [3].
- Neither the Rejoyce Caledon nor Dalemount Child Care listings provide published childcare fees [1], [2], [3].
- Contact information for Rejoyce Caledon is 416-789-1485 [1], [2], and for Dalemount Child Care is 416-781-9493 [3].
- The TDSB address finder is not used to verify childcare eligibility or program availability, as it does not provide verified address-to-school assignments for childcare [4].

No information is available to compare fees, session hours beyond centre hours, or specific program details between the two schools.
